# Snapshot of every id created when protocol/commands.yaml was first seeded.
#
# tests/test_table_invariants.py fails if one of these ids disappears from the table.
# A capability that turns out to be unmappable is marked 'unlocated'; one that the
# decompile shows merged or split keeps its id and gains 'superseded_by'. Neither is
# deleted — a shrinking table looks complete for the wrong reason.
#
# Add to this file only when new VENDOR-PUBLISHED capabilities are seeded. Rows
# discovered by the decompile carry provenance 'decompile' and do not belong here.
